conclusions: Adds a Stage C managed-identity SHADOW that, at a trusted entrypoint with a server-built MemorySearchGovernance, evaluates whether the managed_enterprise canonical-handle path (Stage C #709) would resolve, and records a redacted metric (managed_success / managed_deny / managed_defer). Read-only; builds no manager, creates no directory, writes no Catalog, removes no legacy locator.

Gated + fail-safe by construction: OFF by default (OPENBOT_ITEM7_STAGE_C_IDENTITY_SHADOW); runStageCManagedIdentityShadowIfEnabled is a no-op when off and never throws into the production path when on (errors swallowed + logged). The live-entrypoint canary wiring (calling it from the memory tool) is a coordinated follow-up: src/agents/tools/memory-tool.ts is a shared hot file owned by codex-runtime-safety, so this CR delivers the ready-to-wire evaluator and defers the one-line entrypoint call to avoid a cross-agent hot-file conflict (or it lands with Phase E).

Identity is server-trusted only: managed context is derived from MemorySearchGovernance (ownershipProof + tenantId) via deriveManagedAccessContextFromGovernance, with the acting user threaded as authenticatedUserId (from gatewayClientUser) for seat/group-owned proofs; the canonical resolver port is resolveMemoryWorkspaceHandle. No tenantId/userId/resourceId is derived from wire.

Fail-closed + defer semantics: managed_identity_required / managed_background_deferred / managed_membership_missing are classified as DEFER (no trusted request identity threaded yet -> not a coverage gap); catalog miss / tenant mismatch / grant denied / workspace-not-indexable are DENY. Cross-tenant handles are rejected.

SHADOW ONLY: the five C1-C5 index sites (backend-config / cogniweave-manager / manager / qmd-manager) stay on the legacy path and remain in the retirement scan; physical placement is labeled legacy-local-shadow; no production placement is claimed. Switching C1-C5 (threading identity into those constructor/config-time sites) is the Phase E cutover, not this change.

No scan change (remaining/liveWriteWatchIndex=10, frozenWriteWatchIndex=38); item 7 stays not-met; all locks preserved (deployAuthorized=false, live=forbidden, phase1bExecutionBlocked=true, productionCatalogWrite=none, schemaV2ProductionWrite=false).
